probes.summary: Discovered and inspected PostgreSQL on all three nodes; node1 is writable and node2/node3 are streaming standbys, but replication uses the only observed management network.
limitations: Several initial evaluator SQL queries used unsupported or malformed expressions; corrected queries supplied decisive evidence. Reboot persistence was not tested because no reboot probe was authored.

probes.summary: Committed evaluator data on node1, confirmed exact convergence and standby write rejection, then removed the evaluator schema and confirmed cleanup on all nodes.
limitations: The streaming-topology prerequisite failed due to management-network use, so the dependent assertion is indeterminate by policy.

probes.summary: Read-only inspection completed on all nodes; persistent validation-table and stale backup artifacts remain.
limitations: An initial node1 relation query had a PostgreSQL type ambiguity; a corrected query confirmed the same persistent relation. No cleanup mutation was authorized for these pre-existing artifacts.

assertions.summary: Node1 runs a healthy writable PostgreSQL primary.

evidence.command: sudo -n systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend 'postgresql*'; sudo -n systemctl list-units --type=service --all --no-legend 'postgresql*'; sudo -n systemctl is-active postgresql.service
evidence.observation: postgresql.service is enabled, loaded, active, and running.

assertions.summary: Both standbys are active and streaming, but PostgreSQL replication is using the sole observed management network rather than a dedicated database network.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H -u postgres -- psql -X -d postgres -Atqc "SELECT 'replication|'||coalesce(application_name,'')||'|'||coalesce(client_addr::text,'')||'|'||coalesce(client_hostname,'')||'|'||coalesce(state,'')||'|'||coalesce(sync_state,'')||'|'||coalesce(usename,'') FROM pg_stat_replication ORDER BY application_name; SELECT 'slot|'||slot_name||'|'||active||'|'||coalesce(slot_type,'') FROM pg_replication_slots ORDER BY slot_name;"

ip -4 -o addr show; printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS"; sudo -n -H -u postgres -- psql -X -d postgres -Atqc "SELECT 'identity|'||current_setting('server_version')||'|'||current_setting('port')||'|'||coalesce(inet_server_addr()::text,'')||'|'||pg_is_in_recovery()||'|'||current_setting('transaction_read_only')||'|'||current_setting('default_transaction_read_only');"
evidence.observation: Only eth0=10.100.237.11/24 was present; CLUSTER_HOSTS contains the same node network; identity|16.14|5432||true|on|on.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H -u postgres -- psql -X -d postgres -Atqc "SELECT 'wal_receiver|'||coalesce(status,'')||'|'||coalesce(sender_host,'')||'|'||coalesce(sender_port::text,'')||'|'||coalesce(slot_name,'')||'|'||coalesce(written_lsn::text,'')||'|'||coalesce(flushed_lsn::text,'')||'|'||coalesce(latest_end_lsn::text,'') FROM pg_stat_wal_receiver;"

ip -4 -o addr show; printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS"; sudo -n -H -u postgres -- psql -X -d postgres -Atqc "SELECT 'identity|'||current_setting('server_version')||'|'||current_setting('port')||'|'||coalesce(inet_server_addr()::text,'')||'|'||pg_is_in_recovery()||'|'||current_setting('transaction_read_only')||'|'||current_setting('default_transaction_read_only'); SELECT 'wal_receiver|'||coalesce(status,'')||'|'||coalesce(sender_host,'')||'|'||coalesce(sender_port::text,'')||'|'||coalesce(slot_name,'')||'|'||coalesce(written_lsn::text,'')||'|'||coalesce(flushed_lsn::text,'')||'|'||coalesce(latest_end_lsn::text,'') FROM pg_stat_wal_receiver;"
evidence.observation: Only eth0=10.100.237.12/24 was present; identity reports recovery/read-only; wal_receiver|streaming|10.100.237.10|5432|node3|0/4068108|0/4068108|0/4068108.

failures: No dedicated database network/interface was observed; PostgreSQL listens on node1's management address and replication clients use the corresponding management addresses.

assertions.summary: The exact committed value reached both standbys and both rejected normal writes, but the required streaming-topology prerequisite failed.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H -u postgres -- psql -X -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -Atqc "BEGIN; CREATE SCHEMA evaluator_pg_repl_zqyhjyq_20260828_0921; CREATE TABLE evaluator_pg_repl_zqyhjyq_20260828_0921.probe_row (id integer PRIMARY KEY, value text NOT NULL); INSERT INTO evaluator_pg_repl_zqyhjyq_20260828_0921.probe_row (id,value) VALUES (1,'harbor_eval_zqYHYJq_20260828_0921_node1'); COMMIT; SELECT 'committed|'||value||'|'||pg_is_in_recovery()||'|'||current_setting('transaction_read_only') FROM evaluator_pg_repl_zqyhjyq_20260828_0921.probe_row WHERE id=1;"
sudo -n -H -u postgres -- psql -X -d postgres -Atqc "SELECT value FROM evaluator_pg_repl_zqyhjyq_20260828_0921.probe_row WHERE id=1"
evidence.observation: Exact evaluator value converged on polling attempt 1; final receive/replay LSN was 0/408C7E8.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H -u postgres -- psql -X -d postgres -Atqc "SELECT value FROM evaluator_pg_repl_zqyhjyq_20260828_0921.probe_row WHERE id=1"
evidence.observation: Exact evaluator value converged on polling attempt 1; final receive/replay LSN was 0/408C7E8.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H -u postgres -- psql -X -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -Atqc "BEGIN; INSERT INTO evaluator_pg_repl_zqyhjyq_20260828_0921.probe_row (id,value) VALUES (2,'should_not_persist_node2'); ROLLBACK; SELECT 'write_accepted';"
evidence.observation: INSERT rejected: ERROR: cannot execute INSERT in a read-only transaction.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H -u postgres -- psql -X -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -Atqc "BEGIN; INSERT INTO evaluator_pg_repl_zqyhjyq_20260828_0921.probe_row (id,value) VALUES (2,'should_not_persist_node3'); ROLLBACK; SELECT 'write_accepted';"
evidence.observation: INSERT rejected: ERROR: cannot execute INSERT in a read-only transaction.

limitations: Prerequisite postgresql-two-streaming-standbys failed, so this dependent assertion is indeterminate despite successful functional replication evidence.

assertions.summary: Services, packages, listeners, and debug settings are otherwise clean, but a persistent validation table and stale backup files remain.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H -u postgres -- psql -X -d postgres -Atqc "SELECT 'user_relation|'||n.nspname||'.'||c.relname||'|'||c.relkind::text||'|'||pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname <> 'information_schema' ORDER BY 1;"
evidence.observation: public.replication_validation_pkey and public.replication_validation remain. No backup_label.old exists on node1.
/var/lib/pgsql/data/backup_label.old remains, owned by postgres mode 600; public.replication_validation and its index remain.
The same /var/lib/pgsql/data/backup_label.old artifact remains, owned by postgres mode 600; public.replication_validation and its index remain.

evidence.command: sudo -n systemctl --failed --type=service --no-legend; sudo -n ss -ltnp; rpm -qa | LC_ALL=C sort | grep -Ei '(^|[-_.])(postgresql|pgbouncer|pgpool|haproxy|mysql|mariadb|redis|memcached)([-_.]|$)' || true; sudo -n -H -u postgres -- psql -X -d postgres -Atqc "SELECT 'setting|'||name||'='||setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('log_statement','log_min_messages','log_min_duration_statement','debug_print_parse','debug_print_rewritten','debug_print_plan','track_functions','track_io_timing','shared_preload_libraries','session_preload_libraries','local_preload_libraries') ORDER BY name;"
evidence.observation: No failed services; only PostgreSQL packages plus normal SSH/PostgreSQL listeners; debug settings are off/normal; postgres-owned .pgpass is mode 600 and is legitimate.

failures: public.replication_validation and its primary-key index remain on all three nodes.
/var/lib/pgsql/data/backup_label.old remains on node2 and node3 as stale backup residue.
limitations: The probe did not authorize mutation of these pre-existing artifacts.

actions_performed: Discovered protected local PostgreSQL access on all nodes.
Created and committed evaluator-owned data on node1.
Confirmed exact convergence and standby write rejection.
Dropped the evaluator schema on node1 and confirmed its removal on node2 and node3.
Closed live evidence after all checks and cleanup.
overall_summary: Functional replication works and node1 is writable. The dedicated database-network requirement fails, so the dependent replication assertion is indeterminate by prerequisite policy. Operational-state cleanliness fails due to the persistent validation table on all nodes and backup_label.old on node2/node3. Reboot persistence was not directly tested because no reboot-authorized probe was included.
